column4: Seller supplied text is injected raw into a JSON-LD script block so a closing script tag breaks out into HTML
column5: DynamicSEO emits structured data at src/SEO/DynamicSEO.tsx:212-219 as produces that exact text inside the JSON. The browser terminates the script element at that sequence and parses everything after it as HTML. The values reaching this block are seller authored in a multi seller marketplace - the product page builds its schema from generateProductSchema(product) and a breadcrumb carrying product.title and product.category_name at src/pages/products/[slug]/index.tsx:136-149 - the store page passes storeSchema plus a breadcrumb carrying store.name at src/pages/stores/[slug]/index.tsx:320 and :336 - and the category and brand pages do the same. WHAT IS VERIFIED HERE - the injection is raw and unescaped and seller controlled fields feed it. WHAT IS NOT VERIFIABLE FROM THIS REPOSITORY - whether the panel constrains the characters allowed in a product title or a store name. A title is normally treated as plain text so it is far less likely to be sanitised than the description fields covered by code review issue 38.

column13: Structured data is emitted with the script terminator escaped - a JSON serialiser that replaces < with \\u003c - so no value can close the script element.
column14: The raw value is written into the script block and can close it.
column15: Stored cross site scripting on public product store category and brand pages - the highest traffic surface of the storefront. Because there is no Content-Security-Policy (code review issue 3) nothing contains it - and because the session token is readable from JavaScript in a cookie (issue 3) and in localStorage (issue 14) a single successful injection yields session theft rather than defacement.
column16: Escape the serialised output before injecting it - replace < with \\u003c and > with \\u003e and & with \\u0026 - or use a serialiser that does this. Apply it at the single emission point in DynamicSEO so every page is covered at once. Independently confirm what the panel allows in a product title and a store name.
